name: nullisland-monorepo
description: Generate deliberately broken geospatial files to test map viewers.
author: Between Collective

scripts.dev: npm run build -w nullisland-core && npm run dev -w nullisland-web
scripts.build: npm run build -w nullisland-core && npm run build -w nullisland && npm run build -w nullisland-web
scripts.cli: npm run build -w nullisland-core >/dev/null && tsx packages/cli/src/index.ts
scripts.check: npm run build -w nullisland-core && npm run build -w nullisland && npm run check -w nullisland-core && npm run soak -w nullisland-core -- cobalt-juniper-aspen vale-onyx-breeze gale-glade-zenith fog-ember-vale && npm run check -w nullisland && npm run lint && npm run smoke -w nullisland && npm run check -w nullisland-web && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.release: npm run check && npm publish -w nullisland-core && npm publish -w nullisland
